notes.text: Uncovered ink y 763-846 (x 602-3561) is the printed first body line 'хребетъ. Изъ четырехъ каменьковъ ...' just under the head; band 2 starts at y 852, so its line 1 sits a line off its ink. It belongs with band 2 (MainZone-Continued), which it continues from the previous page.
Lines 26-27 end in and consist of dot leaders (an omission mark in the text); kept inside the continuing prose band.
